annotations.title: Order a boiler or air conditioning installation

description: Order a fixed-price installation priced by quote_installation, on one of its installation dates. Confirm the chosen option, any extras, the total, the date and the address with the customer before calling this. It sends the customer's name, phone number, email, address and answers about the home to Renzy, and emails the customer their quote. It does not collect or charge a card. The result includes a link for photos of the home. Each call creates a new order, so do not retry a call that succeeded.

answers.description: The answers from the priced quote_installation result

email.description: Email address for the quote and invoice

extras.description: Extras the customer chose, as extra id to quantity, e.g. {"scale-reducer": 1, "trv": 4}. Boilers only.

notes.description: Anything else the customer wants Renzy to know (optional)

package_id.description: package_id of the option the customer chose

postcode.description: Full UK postcode of the installation

product.description: boiler for a new gas boiler, air-conditioning for air conditioning
